title: Malaysia Market Entry — Order Follow-Through and Product Demonstrations
result: 20-unit order with balance paid, pending finance confirmation
summary: Coordinated Malaysian market development across sales, marketing materials, demo preparation and regional team handoffs.
context: The order and demo were different workstreams. The order needed payment confirmation and coordination of installation and shipment. The demo needed a usable prototype and market-facing materials.
decisions: In the July 2 sales record I was assigned to update marketing data with technical colleagues. The local team would update Malaysia project progress; SES would provide marketing materials and follow the white paper, installation and shipment actions.
outcome: The July 2 record says the balance for 20 units had been paid and was awaiting financial confirmation. Installation and shipment were still being arranged. The CV separately records summit event participation in Malaysia.
